hotels.description: Discover the height of luxury at this lavish Fijian resort, set on 35 acres of tropical gardens along the pristine shores of Natadola Beach on Viti Levu. This exclusive coast-hugging retreat boasts three sparkling outdoor pools, a world-class spa and a garden-facing fitness centre, plus a wealth of cultural activities to make every moment in Fiji memorable. When it's time to treat yourself, enjoy international favourites in the casual ambience of Toba Bar & Grill, then watch the sun melt into the horizon with a cocktail in hand at the Kama Lounge & Bar. For a bountiful buffet spread with stunning ocean views, head to Sanasana, and for a sweet afternoon treat, swing by Lai Lai Cafe. At the acclaimed Navo Specialty Dining, Fijian flavours are reimagined in a fine-dining setting steps from the ocean. Golf enthusiasts can perfect their swing at the resort's 18-hole championship course and those seeking adventure will find the wonders of Fiji are just waiting to be explored right at your doorstep, including the spectacular underwater world of the resort’s house reef.
